name: @cat-factory/deploy-backend
description: Example Cloudflare Worker deployment of the @cat-factory/worker library. Carries the wrangler.toml + config; copy this package to deploy the backend on your own Cloudflare account.

scripts.image:publish:ui: docker build -f ../../backend/internal/executor-harness/Dockerfile.ui --build-arg BASE_IMAGE=ghcr.io/kibertoad/cat-factory-executor:1.137.0 -t cat-factory-executor-ui:1.137.0 ../../backend/internal/executor-harness && wrangler containers push cat-factory-executor-ui:1.137.0
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply cat_factory --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply cat_factory_telemetry --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply cat_factory_audit --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply cat_factory --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply cat_factory_telemetry --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply cat_factory_audit --remote
